description: The plot, titled "BBQ," illustrates the relationship between the number of demonstrations and accuracy for four different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Demonstrations" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick marks at regular intervals of 250. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks at 45, 50, and 55, indicating an interval of 5. There are four lines plotted. The "Squared-Exponential" line is dark blue with a solid style and circular markers; it starts at an accuracy of approximately 53 near 25 demonstrations, rises to about 56 at 250 demonstrations, and remains relatively steady to end at a peak of approximately 56.2 at 1500 demonstrations. The "Tanh" line is medium blue with a solid style and circular markers, maintaining a steady trend that starts at approximately 48.2 near 25 demonstrations, dips slightly to 47.9 at 750 demonstrations, and ends at 48.0 at 1500 demonstrations. The "ELU" line is light purple with a solid style and circular markers, showing a flat trend that begins at approximately 46.3 near 25 demonstrations and ends at 46.4 at 1500 demonstrations. Finally, the "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" line is pink with a dash-dot style and no markers; it forms a constant horizontal line at an accuracy of approximately 43 across the entire x-axis range and is accompanied by matching pink text in the lower right area of the plot.
